_comment: V23 plugin-mode MCP template. The hook-owned MemPalaceMcpLauncher derives all plugin-data seams at process start and launches the exact vendored-patches.lock package pin from the provisioned uv environment. Runtime indirection is required because static JSON cannot hash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA} into a short, install-unique AF_UNIX socket. This template is source/reference only; dos-emit-plugin-marketplace.ts emits the same inline launcher declaration.
